QuestInfo.name: The Resistance Message
QuestInfo.0: Someone answered the phone. Kepp talking.
QuestInfo.1: The stranger promises to give you the most recent intel as thanks for saving the kids. Keep talking.
QuestInfo.2: The voice belonged to a Resistance member, who told you more about the #bBlack Wings#k. The Black Wings are collecting enormous amounts of energy from Edelstein, probably for a massive experiment.
QuestInfo.summary: Talk to Resistance using a public phone.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,600
Can proceed to Delivering the Message

0.0:
Are all Cygnus Knights as stubborn as you are? 
(The speaker's voice is disguised. They sound mildly annoyed, though.)
#L0##bAre you from the Resistance?#l
#k
0.1: Correct. What is it that you want?\r\n#L0##bThe Black Wings are active on Victoria Island again. I just want to know why.#l\n#k
0.2: I see. And you expect us to share that information with you?\r\n#L0##bWe have a common enemy. I believe we can help each other.#l\n#k
0.3: Let me make this clear up front: we have no intention of allying with you. However, you aided our kids, and we will not be in your debt. I will give you this information and then we will be even.

no.0: Are you deaf? I said, we will NOT be in your debt.

1.0: The #bBlack Wings#k are directing all of Edelstein's vast energy resources to a single spot. Because of that, the city's been experiencing rolling blackouts.
1.1: It's affecting the city's power plants, fish factory, lighting system, even our water supply... And it's all to fuel the #bBlack Wings'#k top secret #rexperiment#k.
1.2: We don't know what the experiment is. If we did, well, we wouldn't tell you. But I will tell you this: they've been stealing #bSeal Stones#k from Maple World. The two are probably related.

yes.0: I have said enough. Our debt has been paid. Go home, Cygnus Knight. \r\n(The phone goes dead.)
